key_reasoning.reason: Three cooperating components inside the Claude agent plugin: tier resolution and picker synthesis in claude.models (new supportsOneMillionContext table, splitOneMillionSuffix, isRouterLikeEntry, [1m] carry-over in resolveClaudeModel, synthesized [1m] rows in buildModelPickerOptions), the model-swap warning wording in claude.plugin keyed on the new resolution reason, and [1m]-tolerant router/label lookups in the detached statusline. No shared core utilities or other plugins touched.

No exact precedent for a version-pattern capability table; the regex boundary (haiku excluded, sonnet/opus 4.6+ and gen 5+, version-first ids) decides whether a launch sends [1m] to a model that cannot honor it. Mitigated by conservative default=false, router exclusion, double-suffix guards and a fallback to the bare id. Existing resolution/picker/statusline test suites were extended rather than new defensive templates invented, so no edge-case bump applied.

6 files changed (3 source, 3 test), all modified, within src/agents/plugins/claude/ and its plugin/ subdirectory; 480 insertions are dominated by test cases. Maps to M on the actual-mode diffstat scale (4-6 files).

Nearest bundle anchor s/epmcdme-10102 (total 11) is narrower in scope and risk; adjacent m/epmcdme-10202 (total 15) spans two subsystems with new files. This change sits between them at the top of S. Borderline 14 kept at S: Technical Risk is M and existing resolution/picker patterns cover most of the implementation.
